entry.name: Duy Duc Dao
entry.university: CNRS (Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique)
entry.department: Institut pluridisciplinaire Hubert Curien (IPHC), Département Recherches Subatomiques, Théorie

evidence.currentRole: https://iphc.cnrs.fr/annuaire/fiche/?nom=Duy+Duc-DAO — live individual employer profile: "Duy Duc DAO", "Chercheur", "Département DRS", "Groupe Théorie", duc.dao@iphc.cnrs.fr. URL followed from the actual Voir la fiche link on the IPHC theory page; web tool returned Cache miss, but a direct Python urllib request returned the individual profile successfully. Permanent appointment independently established by https://section04.in2p3.fr/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/CR_session_automne_2023_vfinale.pdf, page 2: titularisation of Duy Duc DAO on 25 September 2023, following contractual recruitment in 2022. Both sources opened in this run.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: https://inspirehep.net/files/12a71b8061ffdd129f9e2d54f762fcc4 — opened doctoral dissertation (HAL tel-02887649; NNT 2019BORD0245), title pages identify Duy Duc Dao, Université de Bordeaux, doctoral specialty Astrophysique, Plasmas, Nucléaire; defended 26 November 2019. Thesis concerns Hartree-Fock calculations for deformed nuclei with general two-nucleon interactions and pairing correlations.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: Vietnamese given-name combination Duy Duc with surname Dao on the individual employer profile. The same doctoral dissertation acknowledgments additionally describe meetings in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City and assistance returning to Bordeaux for doctoral study. No diacritics reconstructed.
evidence.dedup: Ran npm run find-roster-matches -- "Duy Duc Dao" --url "https://iphc.cnrs.fr/annuaire/fiche/?nom=Duy+Duc-DAO" --url "https://inspirehep.net/files/12a71b8061ffdd129f9e2d54f762fcc4". Only hit: vp-1057 Duy Dao, University of Calgary, matched on name. Different person: opened https://profiles.ucalgary.ca/duy-dao, which identifies Business Technology Management, UC San Diego PhD 2017, and software/cybersecurity economics; candidate has Bordeaux nuclear-physics PhD 2019 and CNRS/IPHC nuclear theory appointment. No identity URL match. Checked already-proposed.txt: candidate absent.

possible_move.name: Phu Nguyen-Van
possible_move.note: Employer/track classification discrepancy, not a verified geographical move. Roster says Professor, Tenure-line, Université Paris Nanterre. Opened https://economix.fr/fr/membre/nguyen-van-phu?tab=dt: individual profile identifies Directeur de Recherche at CNRS, affiliated with EconomiX. It also states a current visiting professorship at UMT in Ho Chi Minh City, so physical location needs resolution before any eligibility conclusion. Dedup command with that URL and https://sites.google.com/view/nguyen-van/ matches vp-0523 by name and identical personal website. Other broad name hits are not the identity-resolved match. No roster changes or Issue created, per BRIEF2.

coverage.employer: CNRS — IPHC (Strasbourg), IRCP, MeLiS/SynatAc, IPBS, CiTCoM, EconomiX and other units surfaced by given-name searches
coverage.note: Later-pass discovery used given tokens Huu, Ngoc, Duy, Khai, Kieu, Thuy, Thai, Son, Hao, Duc, Chinh, Nhan and Sang, plus less common family-name leads Dao, Luu, Quach, Ton and Lai. One new candidate verified on an individual employer page with doctorate and permanent-status evidence; Calgary collision resolved live. CiTCoM attempt failed 502. IPHC theory page https://iphc.cnrs.fr/la-recherche/drs-recherches-subatomiques/drs_theorie/ used only to follow its actual individual-profile link; no collective page used as a candidate profile. Already-proposed names were screened out. No claim that every CNRS unit was enumerated.

coverage.employer: INRAE — FARE, EVA/EcoPEPS, IRHS, Ecodeveloppement; discovery also reached BFP, MIAT, MaIAGE, PhAN, LIPME and RECOVER
coverage.note: Given-name searches covered Thi, Huong, Thuy, Bich, Thanh, Phuong, Hanh, Quynh, Minh, Kien, Diep, Quang and Huyen, plus Dao/Huynh. Verified individual pages yielded trainees. Two additional individual-profile fetches failed as recorded above. Other units were search-result discovery only; their snippets were not accepted as appointment evidence. Earlier-proposed BFP and other names were skipped. No new fully verified candidate.

coverage.note: Given-name searches covered Minh, Thao, Hien, Linh, Thanh, Thuy and Bich, supplemented with Dinh, Huynh and Ngo. coverage.employer: Inria — Rennes, Nancy/LORIA, Saclay, Paris/ENS, Grenoble and Sophia Antipolis discovery

Results repeatedly returned PhD/postdoctoral/intern roles, old annual reports, staff without the degree/output threshold, and already-proposed cryptography candidates. Personal individual page resolved a misleading supervisor-title snippet for Hai Nam Pham. Historical Kim Quyen Ly CV not accepted as current Inria evidence. No new fully verified candidate.

coverage.employer: CEA — List, Leti/Liten, IRAMIS/SPEC, IRFU and biology-unit discovery
coverage.note: Search-led coverage used Minh, Tuan, Dung, Thanh, Hoang, Huu, Ngoc and Quoc-Cuong. Leads included Quoc-Cuong Pham, Thanh-Hai Nguyen, Xuan-Hung Nguyen and Thanh-Tra Nguyen, but no current individual CEA profile was verified for them. Repeated results were event programs, thesis advertisements, historical CVs, doctoral students and already-listed/proposed researchers. No collective listing or job advertisement promoted to a candidate. Empty pagesExamined intentionally distinguishes discovery searches from opened individual employer pages.

coverage.employer: IRD — environmental/remote-sensing and Vietnam-partnership discovery, including Data Terra
coverage.note: Search-led coverage used Thanh, Thi, Huong, Ngoc, Bui, Dinh, Hoang, Doan and Truong, followed by Frederic Huynh. Results primarily identified Vietnam-based partner researchers, students, administrators, and non-Vietnamese collaborators. CNES individual interview corroborates Huynh leadership but does not settle affirmative Vietnamese signal or doctorate/recent-paper threshold; withheld. No IRD individual page passed all three verification tests. Coverage is search-led, not an exhaustive staff census.
